label: Beta cell
note: Inside an Islet or Cluster. A cell is endocrine when a hormone, read over its own background in the image, clears the image's hormone level (the ordinary-tissue p99, lowered inside the objects to a 10% local false-discovery rate). The hormones are mutually exclusive (owner, 2026-10-18): it is named by its highest hormone on the cohort scale, here insulin, only when that hormone is at least twice the runner-up (Senior's confirmation margin); under the margin the cell is Excluded. A Single's one cell takes the same rule.

label: Alpha cell

label: Delta cell
note: As Beta cell, with somatostatin the highest hormone.
